Triage: `domain:spec` — the first concrete step this card names is a contract unwind (restoring the retired `'pdf'` value to `view.exportOptions` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, reversing #8010's removal-registry entry), and any card that changes accept/reject behavior on a schema is `domain:spec` regardless of size (existing routing rule, no exception here). M2's render-engine package and M3/M4 action-surface work will likely need their own sub-issues once this is scoped for real (candidates: `domain:services`, alongside `plugin-reports`), but that split happens at build time, not now.

Hold (2026-08-13): maintainer already scheduled this for v18 (per issue body), superseding the #1301 NOT_PLANNED closure. `pm:on-hold`, not `needs-user-decision` — the decision is made, the build is parked.

Restart trigger files:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the retired `'pdf'` export-format enum value and its error-map prescription)
- `docs/PLATFORM_GAPS_FROM_TEMPLATES.md` (gap #9, the origin of #1301)

Hold-condition completion (triage seat, session `session_014qTKTqjme5Fp5BH9iRmy6t`, on-hold weak-hit audit): same boundary-leg gap as #8345 — the v18 park is sound but nothing greppable announces v18 opening, so the card could only wake on incidental trigger-file churn. Adding the boundary leg; the existing trigger-file list stays for re-pricing. Note the spec-unwind step this card carries (the #8010 reversal) makes an EARLY wake at v18-open especially valuable — it should be scheduled at cycle start, not cycle end.

Restart-when: the v18 cycle opens — first true of: `.changeset/pre.json` exists on origin/main, `packages/spec/package.json` version matches `^18.`, a milestone or ref matching v18 exists (`git ls-remote origin 'refs/*v18*'`), or `content/docs/releases/v18.mdx` is created — or a maintainer re-schedules the card
